issues.t: Throttle cable can catch on the dash mat (recall)
issues.sym: The gas pedal sticks or the engine does not drop back to idle when you lift off.
issues.why: An accessory dash mat could rub against the throttle cable and keep it from returning.
issues.next: If the throttle sticks, shift to neutral and stop safely. Have a dealer confirm recall 96V-057 was done.

issues.t: Windshield wipers work on and off (recall)
issues.sym: The wipers stop, start on their own, or ignore the switch, often in rain when you need them.
issues.why: Solder joints on the wiper motor circuit board can crack.
issues.next: Have a dealer check recalls 98V-150 and 03V-159. Avoid driving in heavy rain until it is fixed.

issues.t: Power mirror switch can short and overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A hot plastic or burning smell near the driver's door, or a mirror switch that stops working.
issues.why: The power mirror switch could short internally and overheat, with a risk of fire.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 03V-093 was done. Get any burning smell checked right away.

issues.t: Front brake rotors can crack (recall)
issues.sym: Grinding, clunking, or vibration from a front wheel when braking.
issues.why: Some front rotors were cast from out-of-spec iron and could crack, in the worst case letting the wheel come loose.
issues.next: Stop driving if you hear new noises from a front wheel and have recall 98V-033 checked.

issues.t: "Spider" fuel injector unit clogs or leaks
issues.sym: Hard starting, misfires, rough idle, a check engine light, or a raw fuel smell under the hood.
issues.why: This engine uses one central injector with thin lines and small poppet nozzles feeding each cylinder. The nozzles stick or clog and the lines can leak with age.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure and misfires checked. Treat a fuel smell as urgent because of the fire risk. An updated injector assembly is the usual fix.

issues.t: Intake manifold gasket coolant leak
issues.sym: Coolant level drops with no obvious leak, coolant crust around the intake, a sweet smell, or milky oil.
issues.why: The intake gaskets break down and let coolant seep out or into the oil.
issues.next: Have it pressure-tested soon. If coolant is getting into the oil, stop driving until it is fixed to protect the engine bearings.

issues.t: 4L60-E automatic slipping or failing
issues.sym: Engine revs flare between shifts, missing gears (often third or fourth), slow or no reverse, or dark burnt-smelling fluid.
issues.why: Heat and heavy loads wear out the clutches and internal parts of this four-speed automatic, commonly around the 80,000 to 100,000 mile mark.
issues.next: Avoid towing until it is checked. A transmission shop can confirm whether it needs a rebuild.

issues.t: Rusted brake lines
issues.sym: A soft or sinking brake pedal, a brake warning light, or wet spots near the wheels or along the frame.
issues.why: Steel brake lines running along the frame rust through in road-salt areas and can burst.
issues.next: If the pedal goes soft, stop driving and have the truck towed. Ask your shop to look at the lines every oil change if you live where roads are salted.

issues.t: Fuel pump failure
issues.sym: Long cranking before starting, sputtering or stalling under load, or a no-start.
issues.why: The in-tank electric fuel pump wears out, often somewhere around 80,000 to 100,000 miles.
issues.next: Have fuel pressure tested. Do not keep driving with stalling, since it can leave you stranded in traffic.

issues.t: Fuel pump wiring connector overheats (recall)
issues.sym: Stalling, a no-start, or a fuel smell near the tank.
issues.why: The electrical connector for the fuel pump could overheat, causing stalls or fuel leaks.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 05V-155 was completed. Treat a fuel smell as urgent.

issues.t: Exhaust fumes can enter the cabin (recall)
issues.sym: An exhaust smell inside, especially with the windows closed or when stopped.
issues.why: Plugs in the rear wheelhouse could be loose or missing, letting exhaust gases into the cabin.
issues.next: Drive with windows open and have recall 00V-343 checked right away. Exhaust fumes can cause carbon monoxide poisoning.

issues.t: Power steering pump shaft can break (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes very heavy.
issues.why: The shaft that drives the hydraulic pump could fracture and cut off power steering assist.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 05V-005 was done. If steering turns heavy, slow down and stop safely.

issues.t: Running board light wiring can overheat (recall)
issues.sym: A burning plastic smell, melted running boards, or courtesy lights that flicker or stop working.
issues.why: Wiring for the lights in the running boards could overheat and melt nearby plastic, with a risk of fire.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 03V-094 was completed.

issues.t: Crankshaft position sensor failure (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stalls, cuts out, or cranks but will not start, sometimes only now and then.
issues.why: The crankshaft position sensor could fail intermittently or completely.
issues.next: Have a dealer check recall 07V-521.

issues.t: Clunk from the steering intermediate shaft
issues.sym: A clunk or knock felt in the steering wheel when turning at low speed or over bumps, often coming back after repair.
issues.why: The sliding steering shaft between the column and the steering gear loses its lubrication and binds.
issues.next: A shop can lubricate or replace the shaft as described in GM bulletins. It is annoying more than dangerous, but have loose steering checked.

issues.t: ABS kicks in at low speed
issues.sym: The pedal pulses and the truck feels like it won't stop when braking gently at low speed, sometimes with the ABS light on.
issues.why: Rust buildup on the front wheel speed sensors makes the ABS think a wheel is locking. A recall covered 2000-2002 trucks in salt states.
issues.next: Have the wheel speed sensors and ABS module checked, and ask a dealer about recall 05V-379.

issues.t: Instrument cluster gauges stick or quit
issues.sym: The speedometer, fuel or temperature needles freeze, drop to zero, or read wrong, and warning lights may flicker.
issues.why: The small motors that move each needle fail with age. GM extended coverage on many of these clusters.
issues.next: A cluster repair or replacement fixes it. Ask a dealer whether special coverage 07187A applies.

issues.t: Hydraulic brake booster problems (recall)
issues.sym: A hard brake pedal that takes much more effort to stop the truck.
issues.why: On trucks with hydraulic (hydro-boost) brake assist, a relief valve seal could break or the booster's accumulator could crack.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recalls 04V-045 and 05V-043 were done. Stop driving if the pedal turns hard.

issues.t: Fuel rail parts can crack and leak (recall)
issues.sym: A gasoline smell under the hood or fuel dripping near the engine.
issues.why: A clip on the fuel rail damper or screws on the fuel rail crossover could break, letting fuel leak onto a hot engine.
issues.next: Do not drive with a fuel smell. Have a dealer check recalls 06V-289 and 04V-376.

issues.t: Heated washer fluid system fire risk (recall)
issues.sym: A burning smell or smoke from under the hood, or washer heating that stops working.
issues.why: The heated washer module could short and overheat. GM first added a fused harness, then disabled and removed the module.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recalls 08V-441 and 10V-240 were completed.

issues.t: V8 burns oil
issues.sym: Oil level drops between changes, low oil pressure or low oil warnings, blue smoke at startup, or fouled plugs and misfires.
issues.why: Oil gets past the piston rings and burns. The cylinder deactivation system is widely linked to it.
issues.next: Check the oil often and never let it run low. Ask a dealer for an oil consumption test and any applicable bulletins.

issues.t: Collapsed cylinder deactivation lifter
issues.sym: Ticking or tapping from the engine, a check engine light with misfire codes, rough running, or lost power.
issues.why: The special lifters that let the engine shut off cylinders can stick or collapse, and may wear the camshaft.
issues.next: Have it diagnosed soon. Do not keep driving with a steady misfire and ticking.

issues.t: Cracked dashboard
issues.sym: Cracks in the top of the dash, often near the passenger air bag.
issues.why: The dash top shrinks and cracks after years of sun and heat.
issues.next: Mostly cosmetic. A dash cover helps, but have a cracked air bag cover inspected.

issues.t: Water can damage the fuel pump control module (recall)
issues.sym: Engine stalling, a no-start, or warning lights, often after rain or a car wash.
issues.why: Water could get into the fuel system control module and cause it to malfunction.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 09V-154 was completed.

issues.t: Ignition key can stick in Start (recall)
issues.sym: The key stays in the start position after the engine is running, or turns roughly.
issues.why: The ignition lock cylinder could bind. If the key is left in a bad position, power to systems like the air bags may be affected.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 14V-827 was done.

issues.t: Steering gear shaft can fracture (recall)
issues.sym: Loose, clunky steering, or a sudden loss of steering control.
issues.why: The pitman shaft in the steering gear could crack.
issues.next: Do not drive if the steering feels loose. Have recall 12V-112 checked right away.

issues.t: Shifter can leave Park without the brake (recall)
issues.sym: The shifter moves out of Park without pressing the brake, or with the key out.
issues.why: A fault in the steering column shift interlock could let the transmission leave Park, so the truck could roll away.
issues.next: Always set the parking brake and have a dealer confirm recall 13V-001 was completed.

issues.t: Body control module can short and stall the engine (recall)
issues.sym: Warning lights, electrical glitches, or the engine stalling while driving.
issues.why: Contamination inside a chassis electrical module could cause a short.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 14V-614 was done. A stall in traffic is dangerous.

issues.t: Rear brake caliper bolts may be loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or knocking from the rear wheels when braking, or weaker braking.
issues.why: The bolts holding the rear calipers might not have been tightened properly at the factory.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 13V-342 was completed before regular driving.

issues.t: Hard brake pedal from vacuum pump problems (recall)
issues.sym: A stiff brake pedal and longer stops, often at low speed, sometimes with a brake warning.
issues.why: The engine-driven vacuum pump that powers the brake booster can lose output, cutting brake assist.
issues.next: If the pedal turns hard, press firmly and get off the road safely. Have a dealer confirm recall 19V-645 was done.

issues.t: A/C stops cooling from a condenser leak
issues.sym: The A/C gradually blows warmer, and oily residue may show at the front of the radiator area.
issues.why: The A/C condenser and its lines can crack and leak refrigerant. GM extended coverage for some owners.
issues.next: Have the A/C leak-tested and ask a dealer whether extended coverage applies to your VIN.

issues.t: Harsh or jerky automatic shifting
issues.sym: Jerky or delayed shifts, a clunk when going into gear, shudder, or loss of power while driving.
issues.why: Owners report shifting problems and some outright failures on the automatic in this generation.
issues.next: Have the fluid and transmission software checked and ask the dealer about any bulletins. Get slipping or loss of drive looked at right away.

issues.t: Electric power steering can cut out (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly turns heavy, sometimes with a message on the dash, then may come back.
issues.why: A fault in the electric steering assist motor or its software could drop power assist.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recalls 14V-719 and 18V-586 were completed.

issues.t: Transmission cooler line can leak (recall)
issues.sym: Red fluid under the truck, a burning smell, or smoke from under the hood.
issues.why: A transmission cooler line might not have been fully seated, letting fluid leak onto hot parts.
issues.next: Stop driving if you see smoke or smell burning fluid. Have recall 14V-152 checked.

issues.t: Unexpected braking on one side (recall)
issues.sym: The truck pulls or brakes on one side without you pressing the pedal, usually at low speed.
issues.why: A faulty wheel speed sensor signal could make the stability system apply a brake on its own.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm the software update for recall 19V-761 was done.

issues.t: Air bags may not deploy during a self-test (recall)
issues.sym: Usually none. In rare cases the air bag light may come on.
issues.why: Software could start a self-test while driving, and if a crash happened during it, the air bags and belt pretensioners might not deploy.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 16V-651 was done.

issues.t: Front control arm welds may fail (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the front suspension, wandering, or a wheel that sits at an odd angle.
issues.why: Poor welds on the front lower control arm could let it separate, causing loss of control.
issues.next: Do not drive until a dealer confirms recall 16V-256 was done.

issues.t: Transfer case missing a part (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Clunking or grinding from under the truck, or sudden wheel lockup, on certain 2015 and 2017-2020 four-wheel-drive models.
issues.why: A part could be missing from a replacement transfer case, which can lock the front or rear wheels.
issues.next: Do not drive until a dealer checks your VIN for recall 26V-289.

issues.t: Rear seat belts may not lock for child seats (recall)
issues.sym: A belt-installed child seat stays loose because the belt will not lock.
issues.why: The rear belt retractors could fail to switch into their child-seat locking mode.
issues.next: Use the LATCH anchors and have recall 18V-673 checked.

issues.t: Fuel pump missing pressure regulator (recall)
issues.sym: A fuel smell, a fuel leak, or rough running.
issues.why: Some fuel pumps were built without a pressure regulator, which can over-pressurize the fuel system and cause leaks.
issues.next: Do not drive with a fuel smell. Have recall 19V-837 checked.

issues.t: Power steering assist can drop out (recall)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly turns heavy, often with a warning message.
issues.why: A software problem could switch off the electric power steering assist.
issues.next: Have a dealer apply the update for recall 21V-455.

issues.t: Fuel pump control module can cause stalling (recall)
issues.sym: The engine stumbles, loses power, or stalls while driving.
issues.why: The fuel pump control module could interrupt fuel delivery.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 21V-739 was completed.

issues.t: Rear driveshaft may break (recall)
issues.sym: Vibration, clunking or banging from under the truck, or sudden loss of drive.
issues.why: Some rear driveshaft parts were not properly heat-treated and could fail.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 22V-036 was done. Stop driving if you feel new vibration from underneath.

issues.t: Rear wheels can lock up (recall)
issues.sym: Sudden harsh downshift or rear wheel lockup while driving, sometimes with a transmission warning.
issues.why: A valve in the automatic transmission's control system could fail and lock the rear wheels. GM is updating transmission software.
issues.next: Have a dealer apply recalls 24V-797 or 26V-085 as they apply to your VIN. Until then, drive cautiously and leave extra following room.

issues.t: Third-row seat belts can be damaged (recall)
issues.sym: A third-row belt is trapped, frayed, or a buckle feels loose.
issues.why: Belts could get caught behind the seat mechanism, and some buckles had a poorly formed rivet.
issues.next: Inspect the third-row belts and have a dealer check recalls 21V-190 and 22V-617.

issues.t: Daytime running lights stay on with headlights (recall)
issues.sym: Daytime running lights stay bright at night along with the headlights, which can add glare.
issues.why: A software setting kept the daytime lights on when the headlights were on.
issues.next: Have a dealer apply the software fix for recalls 22V-827 and 22V-903.

issues.t: 6.2L V8 rod or crankshaft failure (recall)
issues.sym: Knocking from the engine, rough running, a check engine light, or sudden loss of power.
issues.why: Manufacturing defects in the connecting rods or crankshaft can lead to sudden engine failure.
issues.next: Stop driving if the engine knocks. Have a dealer check your VIN for recall 25V-274.

issues.t: Rear control arm bolts can break (recall)
issues.sym: Clunking from the rear, the truck wandering, or a change in how it tracks.
issues.why: Bolts holding the rear outer control arms could break.
issues.next: Have a dealer confirm recall 23V-642 was done. Stop driving if the rear feels loose.

issues.t: Wrong front hub bolts can work loose (recall)
issues.sym: Clicking or clunking from a front wheel, a wobble or vibration that gets worse with speed, or a wheel that feels loose.
issues.why: Trucks built with the largest wheels got incorrect bolts on the left and right front wheel hubs, and those bolts can loosen or deform.
issues.next: Run your VIN for this recall and have the hub bolts replaced. If a front wheel is making new noises or feels loose, stop driving it.

issues.t: Transfer case may be missing a part and lock the wheels (do-not-drive recall)
issues.sym: Usually no warning at all; the front or rear wheels can suddenly lock while you are driving.
issues.why: A component was left out of some four-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive transfer cases, which lets the unit seize.
issues.next: Do not drive it. Check the VIN and arrange a tow to the dealer for the free repair.
